config.purpose: Core-only floor check on pilot-v2 validation; not a specialization or cost-reduction claim
config.decode: manual greedy argmax; KV cache; batch size 1
config.primary_metric: Strict exact match, reported descriptively by language/domain/difficulty
config.acceptance: All 432 validation rows are retained with no errors. Accuracy does not gate dataset acceptance and does not demonstrate specialization.

memory_method: process lifetime ru_maxrss (not per-example GPU peak)
latency_method: tokenization through detokenization, synchronized; model load excluded
timeout_method: cooperative token-boundary deadline; cannot interrupt one forward
